additions.reason: The niggun (melody) is the central concept of the entire Torah. It is the dominant node of Package 1, the heart of the teaching. All other bechina relationships in this Torah orbit around it.

additions.reason: The Rebbe states explicitly 'הַנִּגּוּן הוּא הִתְבָּרְרוּת הָרוּחַ' — the niggun IS the clarification/refinement of the spirit. This is a direct bechina equivalence: niggun and התברורות הרוח are two names for the same essential reality. They belong in the same package as ניגון.
additions.source_quote: כִּי הַנִּגּוּן הוּא הִתְבָּרְרוּת הָרוּחַ, שֶׁמְּבָרְרִין רוּחַ הָאָדָם מִן רוּחַ הַבְּהֵמָה

additions.reason: Jacob's instruction 'קְחוּ מִזִּמְרַת הָאָרֶץ' is interpreted as 'שֶׁיִּקְחוּ בְּחִינַת הַנִּגּוּן הַנַּ"ל, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת זִמְרַת הָאָרֶץ'. The niggun is bechina of zimrat ha-aretz — they are the same essential thing, the melody that belongs to the land of Israel. Belongs in Package 1 with ניגון.
additions.source_quote: שֶׁיִּקְחוּ בְּחִינַת הַנִּגּוּן הַנַּ"ל, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת זִמְרַת הָאָרֶץ כַּנַּ"ל

additions.reason: The Rebbe says each herb sings its song, 'שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת פֶּרֶק שִׁירָה', and 'מִשִּׁירַת הָעֲשָׂבִים נַעֲשֶׂה נִגּוּן שֶׁל הָרוֹעֶה'. The song of the herbs and the niggun of the shepherd are the same essential melody; the herb's song is the raw material that becomes the shepherd's niggun. This is bechina (same thing viewed from herb vs. shepherd), not eitza (it is not that the herb's song merely causes the niggun as a separate entity — they share the same essential nature as song).
additions.source_quote: כִּי כָל עֵשֶׂב וָעֵשֶׂב יֵשׁ לוֹ שִׁירָה שֶׁאוֹמֵר, שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת פֶּרֶק שִׁירָה, וּמִשִּׁירַת הָעֲשָׂבִים נַעֲשֶׂה נִגּוּן שֶׁל הָרוֹעֶה

additions.reason: The Rebbe explicitly identifies each herb's song as 'בְּחִינַת פֶּרֶק שִׁירָה'. Perek Shira is the ancient text in which every creature sings its verse of Torah; here it is identified as the same essential reality as the herb's song and thus as the niggun. Belongs in Package 1 with ניגון and שירת העשבים.
additions.source_quote: כִּי כָל עֵשֶׂב וָעֵשֶׂב יֵשׁ לוֹ שִׁירָה שֶׁאוֹמֵר, שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת פֶּרֶק שִׁירָה

additions.reason: The Torah explicitly contrasts ruach ha-adam (human spirit, which ascends) with ruach ha-behema (animal spirit, which descends). The niggun clarifies and separates them. These two spirits form a mirror pair — Package 2 (good: ruach ha-adam) mirrors the evil/descending aspect of Package 3 (ruach ha-behema). The verse from Kohelet is cited as proof: 'מִי יוֹדֵעַ רוּחַ בְּנֵי הָאָדָם הָעֹלָה הִיא לְמָעְלָה'.
additions.source_quote: מִי יוֹדֵעַ רוּחַ בְּנֵי הָאָדָם הָעֹלָה הִיא לְמָעְלָה, וְרוּחַ הַבְּהֵמָה הַיֹּרֶדֶת הִיא לְמַטָּה

additions.reason: The animal spirit is the negative pole in this Torah — it is what the niggun saves the shepherd from. The Torah uses 'רוּחַ הַבַּהֲמִיּוּת' as the danger: the shepherd could descend from human spirit to animal spirit. It is the evil/descending mirror of ruach ha-adam (Package 2). The phrase 'לִרְעוֹת אֶת עַצְמָן' (the brothers went to graze themselves) is cited as the bechina of what it looks like when the animal spirit wins.
additions.source_quote: הָיָה אֶפְשָׁר שֶׁיַּמְשִׁיכוּ וְיוֹרִידוּ אֶת הָרוֹעֶה מִבְּחִינַת רוּחַ הָאָדָם לְרוּחַ הַבַּהֲמִיּוּת

additions.reason: The gift items that Jacob sent (tzori, honey, spices, nuts, almonds) are identified as 'בְּחִינַת מִשְׁקוֹלוֹת וּמִדּוֹת הַנִּגּוּן' — the weights and measures of the niggun. These are the structural units/proportions of the melody, making them a neutral structural concept (like letters or body parts) that gives form to the niggun.
additions.source_quote: הֵם בְּחִינַת מִשְׁקוֹלוֹת וּמִדּוֹת הַנִּגּוּן, כִּי הַנִּגּוּן נַעֲשֶׂה מִגִּדּוּלֵי הָאָרֶץ כַּנַּ"ל

additions.node_text: מִנְחָה (צֳרִי, דְּבַשׁ, נְכֹאת, לֹט, בָּטְנִים, שְׁקֵדִים)
additions.reason: The gift items (mincha) Jacob sent are explicitly identified as the bechina of the weights and measures of the niggun. They are the concrete objects that map onto the structural measures of the melody. They share essential nature with משקולות הניגון and therefore form a package together.
additions.source_quote: וְהוֹרִידוּ לָאִישׁ מִנְחָה, מְעַט צֳרִי, מְעַט דְּבַשׁ, נְכֹאת וָלֹט, בָּטְנִים וּשְׁקֵדִים – הֵם בְּחִינַת מִשְׁקוֹלוֹת וּמִדּוֹת הַנִּגּוּן
